en.del_s3p2: In the same place you can also delete only your data, delete your chat history, or withdraw your consent to AI processing – if you would rather keep the account itself.
en.del_s3p1: You can delete your account yourself in the app: Profile → Data and privacy → Danger zone → Delete account. This removes your data and your login, and cannot be undone.
en.del_s4p2: Two things are kept. We are required to retain purchase and accounting records for 5 years under the Norwegian Bookkeeping Act; these contain only transaction details – not your health data or your conversations. Bug reports and app ratings you have submitted are not removed automatically; email post@fodmapp.com if you want those deleted too.
en.del_s4p1: When your account is deleted, the following is removed: name, email address, login details, subscription and trial status, your AI conversations, your food and symptom entries, the AI’s analyses, and your usage counters. Data is deleted within 30 days, and removed from backups within 90 days.
en.del_s1p3: Text and images you send to the AI are processed by Google’s Gemini models, through Firebase AI Logic and Vertex AI, as our data processor and on the basis of the explicit consent you give in the app. Because this involves health data, you can withdraw that consent at any time under Profile → Data and privacy.
en.del_s1p2: Photographs are not stored on our servers. They are sent straight to the AI provider for the analysis and discarded afterwards. Images uploaded by older versions of the app are deleted automatically within 48 hours. Your AI chat conversations are deleted automatically after 24 hours. Your food and symptom entries are stored on your account until you delete them, withdraw your consent, or delete your account – all of which you can do in the app.
en.pp_s17p:
Data controller: Telemark Software Solutions AS

en.pp_s16p:
We may update this privacy policy, for example when we introduce new features or when the rules change. The date and version number are shown at the top of the page.

In the case of material changes, we will notify you in the app or by email in good time, and where the law requires it we will ask for your consent afresh. Older versions are available on request.
en.pp_s15p:
Our website uses only what is necessary to make the site work. We store your choice of language and your response to the cookie banner locally in your browser. We do not use advertising cookies, and we do not track you across other websites.

The website loads typefaces from Google Fonts, which means your IP address is transmitted to Google when a page loads. The app itself uses Firebase Analytics as described in section 3(e).
en.pp_s14p:
The AI features generate information, assessments and recommendations, but they do not make any decision that has legal effect for you or otherwise significantly affects you within the meaning of Article 22 of the GDPR. You always decide for yourself what you eat.

We do not carry out profiling for advertising purposes, we do not use your health data to build marketing profiles, and we do not disclose data to advertising networks.
en.pp_s13p: FODMAPP is not intended for children. You must be at least 16 years old to create an account and use the app. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16. If you are a parent or guardian and believe that a child has nevertheless provided us with personal data, please contact us at post@fodmapp.com and we will delete the information.
en.pp_s12p:
You have the right to:
  • Access – be told what data we hold about you and receive a copy
  • Rectification – have incorrect data corrected
  • Erasure – have your data deleted, including the right to be forgotten
  • Restriction – ask us to limit our processing
  • Object – object to processing based on our legitimate interest
  • Data portability – receive your data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format
  • Withdraw consent – at any time, without giving a reason
  • Lodge a complaint – with a supervisory authority
To exercise your rights, contact post@fodmapp.com. We reply without undue delay and no later than one month. See also our Delete account page.

If you believe we are processing your personal data unlawfully, you may complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet), postboks 458 Sentrum, 0105 Oslo, www.datatilsynet.no. If you live in another EEA country, you may also complain to the supervisory authority in your own country.
en.pp_s11p:
We use encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS) for all communication between the app, our servers and our providers. Passwords are stored hashed and are never available to us in plain text. Access to production data is restricted to the small number of people who need it, and is protected by two-factor authentication.

If a personal data breach occurs that is likely to result in a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify the Norwegian Data Protection Authority within 72 hours, and we will notify you where the law requires it.
en.pp_s10p:
• Account data – for as long as you have an account. On deletion, data is removed within 30 days, and from backups within 90 days.
  • AI chat conversation history – deleted automatically after 24 hours. You can also delete it yourself at any time in the app.
  • Food and symptom entries – until you delete them, withdraw your consent, or delete your account.
  • Images – not stored. Images uploaded by older versions of the app are deleted within 48 hours.
  • Crash reports – up to 90 days.
  • Usage statistics in Google Analytics – up to 2 months at user level. Aggregated reports, which cannot identify you, are kept longer.
  • Usage counters on your account – for as long as you have an account.
  • Purchase and accounting records – 5 years after the end of the financial year, as required by the Norwegian Bookkeeping Act.
  • Record of consent to marketing – for as long as the consent is in force, and for up to 3 years after it is withdrawn, as documentation.
  • Support correspondence, bug reports and app ratings – up to 2 years.
en.pp_s10h: 10. How long we keep your data
en.pp_s9p:
Our database is located in the EU (Firestore, European multi-region), and your account data and your entries are stored there.

Some processing nevertheless takes place outside the EEA. The AI processing is not restricted to a European region, and some of our server functions run on infrastructure in the United States. Where personal data is transferred out of the EEA, we rely on the safeguards required by Chapter V of the GDPR: the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses, and/or the provider’s certification under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.

You may contact us at post@fodmapp.com for information about the safeguards that apply to a specific transfer.
en.pp_s8p:
We do not sell personal data. We use the following data processors and providers, all of whom are bound by a data processing agreement or equivalent terms:
  • Google Firebase – authentication, database, storage, crash reporting, performance monitoring and analytics
  • Google (Firebase AI Logic / Vertex AI) – processing of text and images in the AI features
  • RevenueCat – subscription management, using a pseudonymous subscriber ID
  • Apple and Google – as sellers of subscriptions and providers of the app stores
  • Resend – delivery of service emails and newsletters
  • Open Food Facts – product lookups by barcode. Only the barcode is sent; no personal data is transferred
  • OpenStreetMap / Overpass – the toilet finder. Your approximate location is sent in order to look up nearby toilets; it is not stored and is not linked to your account
  • Content delivery networks – the app loads animations (LottieFiles), typefaces (Google Fonts) and certain images from external content networks. Your IP address is transmitted when that content loads; no account data is shared
We may also disclose data where we are required to do so by law, or in order to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.
en.pp_s8h: 8. Who we share your data with
en.pp_s7p:
Service messages

For as long as you hold an account, we send you the emails and notifications needed to deliver the service. These include a welcome email with getting-started information when you become a paying subscriber, confirmation of your consents, receipts and information about changes to your subscription, password and security notifications, operational notices, and notices of changes to the terms or this privacy policy. The basis for these is the performance of our contract with you, Article 6(1)(b), and you cannot unsubscribe from them while you hold an account.

We do not send our own reminder before a free trial ends. Apple and Google notify you themselves before a trial converts into a paid subscription, and you can cancel at any time in your App Store or Google Play account.

Newsletter and marketing

We send our newsletter with low-FODMAP tips, recipes, news and offers only if you switch it on under «Newsletter by email» in the app’s settings. It is off by default, it is separate from your acceptance of the terms, it is voluntary, and it is not a condition for using FODMAPP.

You can switch it off again at any time in the same place, or use the unsubscribe link in any marketing email. We record when consent is given and withdrawn so that we can demonstrate compliance with the rules on electronic marketing.

We do not sell or disclose your email address to others for marketing purposes, and we do not use your health data to target marketing.
en.pp_s6p:
The AI features – AI chat, camera analysis and barcode scanning – are powered by Google’s Gemini models, accessed through Firebase AI Logic and Vertex AI. The requests go from the app to Google’s infrastructure. Our app development platform (FlutterFlow) is not part of this chain and does not receive your content.

What is sent

  • The text you write in the chat
  • A limited amount of health context from your account, so that the answer fits your situation: your trigger profile and safe foods, your stress level, your five most recent symptom logs and your seven most recent meals
  • For the AI analysis: up to 90 days of the entries you have recorded, including meals, symptoms, bowel movements, sleep, stress, menstruation and medication
  • Photographs you submit for analysis, and ingredient lists retrieved for a scanned barcode
  • We do not send your name, email address, user ID or payment information
  • Your stored chat history is not sent to the AI provider – each session starts a new conversation

Why, and on what basis

  • The sole purpose is to generate the answer or analysis you have asked for
  • Because the content contains health data, the basis is your explicit consent, Article 9(2)(a) together with Article 6(1)(a). You give it before the AI features are made available to you
  • Google acts as our data processor and processes the content on our instructions
  • We do not use your content to train our own AI models, and we do not sell it

Storage and deletion

  • Images are not stored on our servers; they are discarded once the analysis is complete
  • Chat messages are deleted automatically after 24 hours – both by the app and by an hourly server routine. You can also delete the conversation history yourself at any time in the app
  • Your food and symptom entries remain on your account until you delete them, withdraw your consent or delete your account. All three can be done in the app
  • The AI provider may retain content for a short period for operational and abuse-monitoring purposes under its own terms, after which it is deleted
  • A limited number of authorised personnel may access content where strictly necessary for troubleshooting, security or handling misuse

Important limitations

  • AI-generated answers may be incomplete or incorrect, and are general information, not medical advice
  • The AI makes no decision that has legal effect for you; see section 14
  • You decide what you write. We encourage you not to include more health information than is necessary to get a useful answer
en.pp_s6h: 6. How your data is processed by AI
en.pp_s5p:
• Creating and operating your account, and delivering the subscription you have purchased – necessary for the performance of our contract with you, Article 6(1)(b).
  • Sending service messages, including welcome information, receipts, security notices and notices of changes to the terms – performance of the contract, Article 6(1)(b).
  • Storing and processing your health-related data and images so the AI features work – your explicit consent, Article 9(2)(a) together with Article 6(1)(a).
  • Sending our newsletter and other marketing – your consent, Article 6(1)(a), and section 15 of the Norwegian Marketing Control Act.
  • Security, troubleshooting, and preventing misuse, fraud and abuse of trial periods – our legitimate interest in a secure and functioning service, Article 6(1)(f).
  • Statistics and improvement of the app, based on aggregated and anonymised data – our legitimate interest, Article 6(1)(f). Fully anonymised data falls outside the scope of the GDPR.
  • Accounting and complying with statutory obligations – legal obligation, Article 6(1)(c).
en.pp_s5h: 5. Why we process your data, and our legal basis
en.pp_s4p:
Information about digestion, symptoms and reactions to food is classified as data concerning health, which is a special category of personal data under Article 9 of the GDPR. Such data may only be processed where a specific condition is met.

We process your health data solely on the basis of your explicit consent under Article 9(2)(a), together with Article 6(1)(a). You give this consent in a separate dialogue in the app before the AI features are made available to you, and it covers the storage of your conversations and entries and the transfer of the content to our AI provider for processing.

The consent is voluntary. You may withdraw it at any time in the app’s settings or by contacting us, and withdrawal is as simple as giving consent. If you withdraw your consent, we stop the processing and delete the stored health data, and the AI features can no longer be made available to you. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.
en.pp_s4h: 4. Health data and your explicit consent
en.pp_s3p:
a) Account data

  • Email address, and first and last name if you provide them
  • Password, stored in encrypted (hashed) form – or your login method if you use Google Sign-In or Apple Sign-In, in which case we receive your name and email address from them, and your telephone number and profile picture where the provider supplies them
  • Language setting, app version and country/region
  • Record of the consents you have given: which version of the terms and privacy policy you accepted and when, whether you have consented to the processing of health data and when, whether you have consented to marketing, and your confirmation that you are at least 16 years old

b) Subscription data

  • Subscription status and type, trial period status, start and renewal dates
  • A pseudonymous subscriber ID with RevenueCat, and the purchase history reported by the app store
  • We never receive or store your card details. Payment is handled entirely by Apple or Google

c) Health-related data

  • The messages you write in the AI chat, including anything you tell us about digestion, symptoms, reactions to food, diagnoses or medication. Chat messages are deleted automatically after 24 hours; see section 10
  • The entries you record in the app: meals, symptom and pain logs, bowel movements (Bristol scale), sleep, stress, menstruation and medication
  • Your trigger profile, your safe foods and your reintroduction tests
  • The AI’s analyses, FODMAP scores and recommendations linked to your account
  • The history of the above, which is stored on your account until you delete it, withdraw your consent or delete your account

d) Images

  • Photographs you take or upload for analysis – food, dishes, menus, ingredient lists, barcodes or the contents of your fridge
  • Images are not stored on our servers. They are passed straight to the AI provider for the analysis and discarded once it is complete. Images uploaded by older versions of the app are deleted automatically within 48 hours

e) Technical and usage data

  • Device model, operating system, app version and language
  • Crash and error reports via Firebase Crashlytics, and performance data such as app start-up and network timings via Firebase Performance Monitoring
  • Usage statistics via Google Analytics for Firebase, such as which screens and features are used – including which onboarding steps you complete
  • Simple counters kept on your account, such as how many times you have opened the app and how many chat messages and camera analyses you have used
  • Usage events are linked to an app-instance identifier and to your user ID, and on Android the analytics service may also collect the device’s advertising ID. This data is therefore personal data. We use it only to understand and improve the app – never for advertising, and we do not share it with advertising networks; see section 14

f) Correspondence and feedback

  • Emails and support enquiries you send us, and our replies
  • Bug reports and app ratings you submit in the app, which include your user ID and any text you write

g) Location

  • If you use the toilet finder, your approximate location is sent to the OpenStreetMap Overpass service to look up nearby toilets. We do not store your location, and it is not linked to your account
en.pp_s2p:
• We process information about your diet, digestion and symptoms. This is health data, and we process it only on the basis of your explicit consent.
  • Your AI chat conversations are deleted automatically after 24 hours. The food and symptom entries you record are stored on your account so that you have a history, and you can delete them in the app at any time.
  • Text and images you send to the AI features are transferred to Google’s Gemini models for processing. We do not use your data to train our own AI models.
  • Photographs are not stored on our servers. They are sent straight to the AI provider for the analysis and discarded afterwards.
  • We send you the service messages needed to run your account. Our newsletter is sent only if you switch it on in the app’s settings, and you can switch it off again at any time.
  • We never sell your personal data, and we do not use it for advertising or third-party profiling.
  • You can request access, correction and deletion at any time, and withdraw your consent in the app.
en.pp_s1p:
This privacy policy explains how Telemark Software Solutions AS processes personal data when you use the FODMAPP app and our website. It applies to everyone who uses FODMAPP.

Telemark Software Solutions AS is the data controller for the processing described here. You can contact us at post@fodmapp.com.

FODMAPP is built on Google Firebase for authentication, storage and operations, and uses Google’s Gemini AI models for the AI features. Because the app deals with food, digestion and symptoms, we process health data, and we therefore explain in particular detail below what happens to that information.

If you are dissatisfied, please contact us first at post@fodmapp.com so that we can try to resolve the matter. Consumers elsewhere in the EEA may contact their national consumer body or use the European Commission’s online dispute resolution platform.

Disputes that are not resolved amicably may be brought before the Norwegian courts. If you are a consumer, you may always bring proceedings before the courts of your own country of residence, and legal action may only be brought against you there.
en.tc_s19p:
We may update these terms, for example as a result of new features, changes in our subscription model, or changes in law.

In the case of material changes, we will notify you in the app or by email, and you will be asked to accept the new terms before you continue using the app. If you do not wish to accept them, you may stop using the app and have your account deleted. Minor changes that do not affect your rights – such as clarifications, corrections of typing errors, updated contact details or updated legal references – take effect when they are published. The effective date and version number are shown at the top of this page.
en.tc_s18p:
We process personal data as described in our Privacy Policy, which forms an integral part of this agreement.

Because FODMAPP processes information about your diet, digestion and symptoms, we process health data, which is a special category of personal data. Such processing takes place on the basis of your explicit consent, which you give separately in the app and may withdraw at any time. If you withdraw your consent, we can no longer provide the features that depend on that processing, and the agreement may be terminated for that reason.
en.tc_s17p: Neither party is liable for failure to perform its obligations where this is due to circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including natural events, fire, war, terrorism, sabotage, cyber attacks, pandemics, labour disputes, failures in power supply or electronic communications, decisions of public authorities, or the failure or discontinuation of essential third-party services.

We are not liable for decisions you make on the basis of content in the app, nor for symptoms, health outcomes, allergic reactions, financial loss or other loss arising from your reliance on AI-generated guidance without verifying critical information yourself.

To the extent permitted by law, our total liability for any claim or series of related claims is limited to the higher of the amount you have paid for the service in the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to liability, or NOK 1,000. We are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, including lost profit, lost savings, loss of data or damage to reputation.

If you use the app in breach of these terms or applicable law, you are responsible for the loss this causes, and for third-party claims attributable to that use.

Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law. This includes liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for gross negligence or wilful misconduct, and your non-waivable rights as a consumer. en.tc_s15p:
You may stop using FODMAPP at any time. You can delete your account yourself in the app under Profile → Data and privacy; see also the Delete account page.

We may suspend or terminate your access with immediate effect in the event of a material breach of these terms, unlawful use, fraud, misuse of trial periods or payment mechanisms, chargebacks, or where your use poses a risk to security, to other users or to the operation of the service. In other cases we may terminate the agreement on reasonable prior notice.

On termination your right to use the app ceases. We delete or anonymise your personal data in accordance with the Privacy Policy, subject to any statutory retention obligations. Provisions that by their nature are intended to survive – including those on intellectual property, limitation of liability and governing law – continue to apply after termination.
en.tc_s14p:
FODMAPP relies on third-party services, including the Apple App Store and Google Play, Google Firebase, Google’s Gemini models via Firebase AI Logic and Vertex AI, RevenueCat for subscription management, Resend for email delivery, Open Food Facts for product data, the OpenStreetMap Overpass service for the toilet finder, and external content networks for fonts and animations. These providers have their own terms, and we are not responsible for their content, accuracy or availability.

The app requires an internet connection. We aim for stable operation, but we do not guarantee that the service will be available without interruption, free of errors or accessible at all times. Maintenance, updates, operational incidents and faults in third-party services or in your own device or network may affect availability.

en.tc_s1h: 1. Who we are and what these terms cover

en.tc_s2h: 2. What FODMAPP is – and what it is not
en.tc_s2p:
FODMAPP is an AI-powered app that helps you find your way around the low-FODMAP diet through AI chat, camera analysis and barcode scanning. The app provides general dietary information and educational guidance.

FODMAPP is an information and lifestyle tool. It is not a medical device, and it is not intended for the diagnosis, prevention, monitoring, prediction, prognosis, treatment or alleviation of any disease, injury or disability. The app does not diagnose irritable bowel syndrome or any other condition, does not measure anything in your body, and does not provide individual medical treatment or clinical nutrition therapy.
en.tc_s3p:
The content in FODMAPP is general information and must not be regarded as medical, dietary or other health-related professional advice. No patient relationship arises between you and us, and we do not provide health services.

Always consult a doctor or a clinical dietitian before you start, change or end a diet – and in particular if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, are under 18, or have or suspect a condition such as an eating disorder, diabetes, coeliac disease, inflammatory bowel disease or an allergy. Never postpone seeking medical attention because of something you have read in the app. In an emergency, contact the emergency services in your country.
en.tc_s4p:
Answers, assessments and scores in the app are generated by artificial intelligence and may be incomplete, outdated or simply wrong. FODMAP content varies with brand, recipe, portion size, ripeness and preparation method, and research in the field changes. The FODMAP score from 0 to 100 is an indicative aid, not a measurement result.

Barcode scanning uses product data from third parties, including Open Food Facts, which is contributed by volunteers and which we neither control nor can verify. Always check the actual packaging for ingredients and allergen information.

FODMAPP is not an allergen-detection tool. If you have an allergy or intolerance where exposure can be dangerous, you must never rely on the app alone.
en.tc_s5p:
You must be at least 16 years old to create an account and use FODMAPP. If the law in your country sets a higher age for consenting to the processing of health data, that higher age applies.

You can create an account using email and password, Google Sign-In or Apple Sign-In. You must provide correct information, keep your login credentials confidential and not share your account with others. One account per person. You are responsible for all activity carried out under your account, and you must notify us without undue delay at post@fodmapp.com if you suspect unauthorised use.
en.tc_s6p:
New users get a time-limited free trial period with full access to the app’s features. The trial period is currently 14 days. When the trial period expires, continued access to the AI features requires a FODMAPP Plus subscription.

The trial period is available once per user and per Apple ID or Google account, and may not be used repeatedly by creating new accounts. We may change the length of the trial period, or withdraw it, for new users.

Which features are included, any fair-use limits and current prices are always shown in the app before you make a purchase. We deliberately do not state usage limits in these terms, because they may be adjusted over time in accordance with section 9.
en.tc_s7p:
Subscriptions are sold as in-app purchases through the Apple App Store or Google Play. Your purchase agreement is entered into with Apple or Google, who act as seller and handle payment, receipts, renewals and refunds. We deliver the service itself.

Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial period or the current subscription period expires, the subscription renews automatically and the app store charges the price applicable at that time. You can cancel at any time under subscription settings in your App Store or Google Play account. Cancelling stops future renewals, and you keep access for the remainder of the period you have paid for. Note that deleting the app does not in itself cancel a subscription.

Refunds are handled by Apple or Google under their own terms. We are not able to process refunds for purchases made through the app stores.
en.tc_s8p:
As a consumer in the EEA you normally have a 14-day right of withdrawal when purchasing digital services. Because access is made available immediately, you expressly request that performance begins at once when you start using the service, and you acknowledge that the right of withdrawal lapses once the service has been fully performed.

For purchases made through the Apple App Store or Google Play, withdrawal and refund requests are handled under the terms of the relevant app store. Your statutory rights as a consumer are not affected by this section.

en.man_intro: FODMAPP gives you three powerful tools to navigate the low-FODMAP diet: the AI camera for photo analysis, the barcode scanner, and the AI chat assistant. Here's how to use each one.
en.man_cta_p: Download FODMAPP today and make the low-FODMAP diet simpler.
en.t1p: Make sure there's good lighting and the entire food item or menu is visible in the camera frame for the best analysis.
en.t2p: The camera and barcode features require an internet connection. WiFi gives the fastest and most reliable response.
en.t3p: Use the app whenever you're in doubt – at home, at the supermarket, or at a restaurant. The more you use it, the more confident you'll become.
en.t4p: Photos are not stored on our servers – they are sent straight to the AI for analysis and discarded afterwards. Your AI chat conversations are deleted automatically after 24 hours. Your food and symptom entries are stored on your account so you can look back at them, and you can delete them in the app whenever you want.
en.man_chat_title: What can you ask the AI?
en.man_chat_sub: Type a question and get an answer in seconds – in your own language, 24/7.
en.ch1p: Type a food, dish, or product name and get an instant FODMAP rating with explanation, portion advice, and safe alternatives.
en.ch2p: Describe a restaurant dish and the AI assesses each ingredient, explains the FODMAP risks, and suggests how to order it low-FODMAP.
en.ch3p: Ask for a full low-FODMAP weekly menu with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks – the AI creates a varied and balanced plan with recipes.
en.ch4p: After your meal plan, ask for a shopping list. The AI generates one based on the menu so you always have the right ingredients at home.
en.ch5p: Ask what FODMAP is, which types exist (fructans, galactans, polyols, fructose, lactose), how the diet works, or anything else related to FODMAP.
en.ch6p: Stress can worsen IBS symptoms. Ask the AI for relaxation techniques, breathing exercises, and practical tips for long-term stress management.
en.man_cam_sub: Point the camera, take a photo – and get an instant FODMAP analysis with a score from 0 to 100.
en.cam1p: Photograph a fruit, vegetable, or ingredient to instantly find out if it's low or high FODMAP – with portion advice and safe alternatives.
en.cam2p: Photo an entire meal and the AI identifies all ingredients, assesses each one, and checks for FODMAP stacking – where several moderate items together exceed the safe limit.
en.cam3p: Photo a menu in any language and get suggestions for safe dishes, with specific tips on what to ask the waiter to change or leave out.
en.cam4p: Photo your fridge and the AI lists all recognisable ingredients with FODMAP status, then creates two low-FODMAP recipe suggestions based on what you have.
en.cam5p: Photograph a drink – juice, smoothie, or soft drink – and get a full FODMAP assessment including information about sweeteners and safe portion sizes.
en.cam6p: Every camera analysis gives you a FODMAP score from 0 to 100. Green (80–100) means safe, yellow (55–79) means moderate caution, and red (below 55) means high FODMAP content – so you can decide at a glance.
en.man_bc_title: Instant product checks in the store
en.man_bc_sub: Point the camera at any product's barcode and get a full FODMAP assessment in seconds.
en.bc1p: The barcode scanner taps into Open Food Facts – one of the world's largest open food databases with over 4.4 million products from countries around the globe. Whether you're at home or travelling abroad, chances are the product is already in the database.
en.bc2p: When you scan a barcode, the app fetches the full ingredient list and analyses every ingredient with advanced AI – giving you a complete, reliable FODMAP verdict.
en.bc3p: Use the scanner before putting anything in your trolley. It works with packaged products from any country – perfect when travelling or shopping at international stores.
en.c2p: Scan a product's barcode and get an instant FODMAP assessment. With access to over 4.4 million products in the Open Food Facts database, it works on products from virtually any country.
en.feat_sub: Over 4.4 million products – every ingredient analyzed by AI. No guessing, no searching. Just snap a photo, scan, or ask.
en.cta_p: Download free. Eat without fear. iOS & Android – 23 languages.
